description: Metropolitano de Tenerife, S.A.: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Metropolitano de Tenerife, S.A.. Coverage: Metropolitano de Tenerife, S.A.. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Información sobre el sistema de transporte de Metropolitano de Tenerif; Paradas de tranvía en la isla de Tenerife; Líneas de tranvía en la isla de Tenerife; Frecuencia del servicio de tranvía en la isla de Tenerife. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, GEO%2BJSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
